d: Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture.

At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

On an exclusive island in the heart of the Kingdom’s capital, Four Seasons Hotel Bahrain Bay, with its unique architecture, has become an iconic landmark that soars as a destination in its own right, combining the best of a beach holiday and an urban getaway.

We are looking for a passionate and skilled Chef de Partie to join the culinary team of our specialty restaurant. The ideal candidate will have a strong culinary background, preferably with experience in Lebanese, Levantine, or Middle Eastern cuisine, and a genuine passion for delivering high-quality food and exceptional guest experiences.

The Chef de Partie will be responsible for managing an assigned section of the kitchen, maintaining the highest standards of food quality, presentation, hygiene, and consistency while supporting the overall kitchen operation.
q: Previous experience as a Chef de Partie in a luxury hotel, fine-dining restaurant, or high-quality specialty restaurant.
Previous hands-on experience in Lebanese cuisine is required.
Strong knowledge of traditional Lebanese dishes, ingredients, preparation methods, and cooking techniques.
Experience preparing hot and cold mezze, grills, and other Lebanese specialties.
Culinary diploma or relevant professional culinary qualification is preferred.
Good understanding of food hygiene, food safety, and HACCP standards.
Strong attention to detail with a commitment to quality, consistency, and presentation.
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced kitchen environment.
Positive attitude with strong teamwork and communication skills.
Flexibility to work different shifts, including weekends and public holidays.

We are looking for someone who is passionate about culinary excellence, eager to learn, and takes pride in every plate served. The successful candidate will be a team player who brings consistency, creativity, and attention to detail while contributing positively to the kitchen culture.
r: li
Take responsibility for the preparation and operation of an assigned kitchen section.
li
Prepare and present dishes according to established recipes, presentation standards, and portion specifications.
li
Support the preparation of authentic Lebanese and Levantine dishes, including hot and cold mezze, grills, and other specialty items.
li
Ensure consistency in taste, quality, presentation, and portion control.
li
Complete daily mise en place and ensure the section is fully prepared for service.
li
Monitor food quality, freshness, storage, and rotation according to food safety standards.
li
Maintain a clean, organized, and hygienic working environment at all times.
li
Assist with receiving and checking ingredients and ensure proper storage and labeling.
li
Minimize food waste and support effective inventory and cost-control practices.
li
Guide and support Commis Chefs and junior team members within the section.
li
Work closely with the Sous Chef and other culinary team members to ensure smooth and efficient service.
li
Follow all hotel policies, food safety procedures, and health and hygiene standards.
li
Demonstrate teamwork, professionalism, and flexibility in supporting the kitchen operation.

d: NCR Atleos, headquartered in Atlanta, is a leader in expanding financial access. Our dedicated 20,000 employees optimize the branch, improve operational efficiency and maximize self-service availability for financial institutions and retailers across the globe.
Location: Jeddah, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (KSA)

We are seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager to support the delivery of strategic enterprise initiatives within the Capital portfolio for a major financial institution in KSA. This role plays a critical part in driving high-impact projects, coordinating multiple stakeholders, and ensuring successful delivery in a complex financial services environment.

The Senior Project Manager is responsible for leading the planning, execution, and delivery of enterprise-wide projects through an outsourcing engagement. This role requires strong project leadership, stakeholder management, and the ability to coordinate across business, technology, and vendor teams.
The position involves managing project scope, timelines, budgets, risks, issues, dependencies, and governance requirements while ensuring alignment with business objectives and delivery standards.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field
Minimum of 10 years of project management experience
Strong background in banking or financial services
Experience delivering complex enterprise projects and managing multiple stakeholders
Excellent planning, organization, communication, and stakeholder management skills
Fluency in English and Arabic, both written and spoken
Previous exposure to capital markets, investment banking, asset management, or Capital-related initiatives
Professional certification such as PMP, PRINCE2, Agile, Scrum, or equivalent
Offers of employment are conditional upon passage of screening criteria applicable to the job.

d: You’ll lead the delivery of security services for clients in Kuwait, with a focus on SOC planning, design, and build-out. You’ll draw on Accenture’s global delivery network (methods, tooling, accelerators, talent) and tailor it to Kuwaiti clients, whether that’s a bank standing up a new SOC, an energy company monitoring critical infrastructure, or a government entity working toward national cyber security requirements. You’ll manage the delivery team day to day and make the calls that keep programs on track.
q: Strong, hands-on experience planning and building SOCs, including operating models, use case development, and onboarding of log sources
Solid working experience with Splunk SIEM operations
Good grasp of delivery governance, including reporting, risk management, and quality control
Experience leading and developing delivery teams
Ability to communicate clearly with technical teams and client stakeholders alike
Experience in the GCC market and familiarity with regional regulatory expectations
CISSP, CISM, or GCIH (at least one)
Splunk Core Certified Power User or Splunk Enterprise Security Certified Admin
PMP or equivalent project management certification
Nice to have: CISA, CRISC, or GIAC SOC-related certifications
r: li
Lead delivery of SOC and security operations engagements, from planning and design through to steady-state operations
li
Manage and guide your team, making decisions on priorities, resourcing, and approach
li
Track progress against plan and make sure delivery stays aligned with client goals and compliance requirements
li
Spot risks early and put mitigation in place before they hit timelines or service quality
li
Solve problems that cut across teams and workstreams, working closely with other delivery leads
li
Bring fresh ideas to how we deliver, using automation, better tooling, and proven approaches from our global teams
li
Run regular team check-ins and knowledge-sharing sessions so learning spreads fast
li
Gather client feedback and use it to sharpen our services
